newsitem.title: USA: Vermont considers electric co-op for consumers.
newsitem.headline: Vermont considers electric co-op for consumers.

text.p: Vermont state officials are looking at a proposal to create a new consumer-owned electric cooperative.
Public Service Commissioner Richard Sedano said that is one way to make sure that average Vermonters share the benefits of lower electricity rates when the power industry is deregulated.
Sedano said his department is working on plans for a co-op, which would be called ConsumerCo, and which would buy electricity and heating fuel in bulk and pass the savings to low-income consumers.
